description: Result Q Stage 7: extended-precision de-shift weights (iterative refinement with 384-bit fixed-point residuals; corrections from the double-precision pseudo-inverse).  Grids nu_k = (k+1/2) dnu with dnu given EXACTLY as a fraction.  C4_value / C4_deriv: Stage-4 4-shift EE3 system (R_j of functionals_q4_deshift.json) on the extended grid dnu = 1/25, N = 3072 (nu_max = 122.88), min-norm (tol 1e-11) gauge ON THAT GRID: a gauge change of the stored dnu = 1/50, N = 2048 weights (max relative difference 'dweight', computed against the stored weight interpolated to the new grid).  C5: Stage-5 3-shift general complex system (c = c_re + i c_im, functional Re[c Psi_5/Nhat5]) on dnu = 1/25, N = 2048, correction tolerance 1e-15.  'offgrid' lists (t, |W/Phi - 1|) by direct mpmath quadrature OFF the collocation grid.  C4 pieces: W = Phi to <= 4e-15 for t <= 30.  C5: only to ~1e-6 at t = 15, 8e-4 at t = 20 (no spectral gap; see RESULT_Q_STAGE7.md).  Weights are decimal strings (64 significant digits); evaluate W(t) for t > 10 with >= 50 digits.
